messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hi — I’d like to close my Silver Zoom Card. I’ve found a business card at another bank that seems to have better rewards for my needs.

{"message":"I can help with that. To close your Silver Zoom Card I’ll need to verify your identity first. Please send one of the following so I can look up your account: your Rho-Bank user ID, the email on your account, or your full name. After I look up your account I’ll ask you to confirm any 2 of these: date of birth, email, phone number, or address. Which identifier would you like to provide? If you’d rather speak with a human instead, tell me and I’ll transfer you."}
You can use my full name to look it up: **Margot Bellamy**.
